create_OpenImagesV6_dataset: create an OpenImagesV6 dataset instance with a root directory and train split
load_indices_from_file: load image indices from a text file and filter invalid images for the train split
get_image_by_index: get a transformed image from the OpenImagesV6 dataset by its integer index
get_dataset_length: get the total number of valid images in the OpenImagesV6 dataset
get_image_path: get the full file path for an image given its index in the dataset
